description: The file defines a class TenantClientFactoryImpl that implements a factory pattern for creating and managing TenantClient instances within the Eclipse Hono project. It manages connection states, caching of tenant clients, and provides methods for obtaining or creating tenant-specific clients.

classes.name: TenantClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing TenantClient instances, handling connection status, caching, and client lifecycle management.

methods.name: TenantClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing factory with a connection and optional cache provider.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection event by clearing the tenant client factory state.

methods.name: getOrCreateTenantClient
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an existing tenant client or creates a new one, ensuring connection is active.

methods.name: removeTenantClient
methods.description: Removes a tenant client from the cache based on tenant ID.
